      "body": "I also wanted to anonymize my headers at my mailserver with the documentation from mailcow.\r\n\r\nThat's what I can say:\r\nIt works, but only if the receiver of the mail is outside of the mailserver instance. So for mails between users on the same mailserver the headers won't be removed/replaced. \r\n\r\n@lekron42 can you check it with your instance?"
    },

      "id": 430133810,

      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "@fabianlaule \r\n\r\nJust checked and you are right! It indeed correctly replaces the received header, I just never checked it with a mail address outside of my mailserver. I am going to close this issue now."
    }
